t: Buying house on Gotland
s: While the rental market is comparatively difficult, conditions are considerably better for those who want to buy. There are essentially always houses for sale, and the possibilities of finding something suitable are good, whether it’s in Visby or in the countryside. The price level for purchases varies a great deal. For natural reasons, the central parts of Visby are a bit more expensive, whereas it is possible to find really reasonable prices either on the outskirts of town or in the countryside. The advantage of Gotland is that distances are very short.
